## 改动与效果 / Change

说明触发场景、修改前后的行为。Describe the trigger and the behavior before and after this change.

## 涉及范围 / Scope

列出涉及的模块ID；新增适配说明实际调用的接口、协议或传输方式。List affected module IDs and the interface, protocol or transport used by a new adapter.

## 验证 / Verification

写实际执行的构建或检查，以及实机的型号、控制盒和信号源；未验证项注明。设备适配可附贡献指南中的只读报告。纯文档修改无需构建或实机操作。List only the checks actually run and relevant hardware observations. Device adapters may include the read-only report from the contribution guide. Mark unverified cases. Documentation-only changes need no build or device run.

## 资料来源 / Sources

复制或移植代码时列出来源与许可；仅借鉴思路时简要说明。不要提交签名私钥、SN／MAC等唯一设备标识或提取的厂商APK／固件。Credit copied or adapted code and its license; briefly credit design inspiration. Keep private keys, unique device identifiers and extracted vendor packages out of the PR.
